name: Domantas Sabonis
blurb: Beat ETR in two of three, and both times it came from the role growing: 34 and 39 minutes against a usual near 30, with assists running well above his rate (8 and 10). The one miss against MEM was a quiet night in normal minutes, nothing structural. If the minutes hold in the mid-30s, ETR has been a step behind him.

name: Darius Acuff Jr.
blurb: Steady against ETR: two nights in line and one over, all in 35-37 minutes, so the role looks locked in. The production swings on his shot (9-23 against MEM) and he rarely adds stocks, so the floor is there but the spike depends on efficiency.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
blurb: Scoring has been steady and efficient (13-19, 15-26) all three games; what moves his total is assists, 1 in the opener against 11 Monday. Monday's 39 minutes were his most so far, and ETR has had him above his usual every night, so it's already pricing the bigger role.

name: Anthony Edwards
blurb: Boom or bust on his shot: 45 and 47-point nights when the threes fell, and 5-23 shooting in one of the misses. The other miss was a 23-point blowout that capped him at 28 minutes. Minutes have held at 33+ in competitive games, so there's no role concern behind the swings.

name: Devin Booker
blurb: All over the place: in line, a 43-point eruption (17-25) and then 3 points on 1-7 Monday. Minutes have been normal in all three (29-36), so it's shot volume and variance, not role. Monday's dud looks like a one-off rather than a trend.

name: Cooper Flagg
blurb: Over in both games he played real minutes (33 and 40), and the stocks have shown up every night (4, 4, 8). The one miss was a 16-point blowout that held him to 17 minutes. His usual minutes (28) still trail what he's actually playing, so ETR keeps catching up to him.

name: Nikola Jokic
blurb: Results have tracked his shot more than his role: the miss against OKC was 5-19 shooting, and the big night against NOP came with 44 minutes and 5 stocks. Minutes are where they should be (35-44) and the assists keep coming (10 and 11 the last two), so nothing structural behind the swings.

name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
blurb: Under ETR in two of three, but for different reasons: a cold 6-19 against DEN and foul trouble (5 fouls, 30 minutes) against PHX. When he's shot normally he's beaten his number, so treat the misses as noise rather than a trend.

name: Jalen Johnson
blurb: Solid against ETR: three in line and one big over, a 16-assist night in 38 minutes. His minutes have climbed from 28 to 36-38 in the last two, which is the thing to watch; the assists swing hard night to night (16, then 3).

name: Anthony Davis
blurb: Volatile: one over and two unders inside four games. The misses came on cold shooting (3-12) and a thin all-around night, while he's played 31-36 minutes every time. Assists have nearly disappeared (0 in two of four), so his total leans on scoring and boards.

name: Alperen Sengun
blurb: Never under ETR in four games: two in line and two overs, the latest a 6-steal, 11-15 explosion. Minutes have ticked up to 36-37 in the overs and the playmaking is steady (7-9 assists), so he's earning the bigger number.

name: Donovan Mitchell
blurb: Never under ETR in three games, in steady 35-38 minutes: two overs and an in-line night 4 points short. The 32-point, 10-rebound night was the outlier upside; otherwise he lands around his number.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
blurb: As steady as it gets: in line all three, in 32-35 minutes. The assists (7-12) carry him and the scoring holds around 20, so ETR has had him right.

name: Jamal Murray
blurb: One of each: a 2-11 dud against OKC, a 42-point 43-minute night against NOP, and in line Monday. Minutes are a lock (36-43), so the variance is his shot; there's no role signal here.

name: Trae Young
blurb: In line all four games, in 34-38 minutes. He gets there on assists (9-13) even when he shoots poorly (4-13 in the opener), and he adds almost nothing on stocks. Predictable, which ETR has priced correctly.

name: Ty Jerome
blurb: Mostly over ETR: 45 points against UTA and 31 against SAC, all in 30-32 minutes. The one under was a cold 4-15. The role is stable, so expect his number to keep running a little light while the shot is falling.

name: Amen Thompson
blurb: In line or over for three games in 33-39 minutes, then Monday's 28 minutes in a close game was the outlier, and unexplained. If the minutes come back to the mid-30s, Monday looks like a one-off.

name: Brandon Miller
blurb: Two bad nights before Monday's 39-point eruption: cold shooting both times (7-21, 2-14), one of them in a blowout. Minutes are fine when the game is competitive (36), so this is a shooting roller coaster, not a role issue.

name: Bam Adebayo
blurb: Under ETR in two of three. One was foul trouble (23 minutes), the other cold shooting (3-10). ETR has had him above his usual lately, and he hasn't gotten there yet.

name: Evan Mobley
blurb: Swinging on stocks: none against PHI (under), 5 against BKN (over), in line Monday. Minutes have been steady at 34-38 and the boards hold around 10, so the spread is mostly blocks and steals variance.

name: Kevin Durant
blurb: Around his number in a tight band: two overs, one in line, one under, in 37 minutes most nights. He even went over Monday in only 30, thanks to 5 stocks and 9 boards. Reliable.

name: LaMelo Ball
blurb: Under ETR in three of four. Two of those were blowouts that capped his minutes (23 and 17), but Monday's miss came in 31 minutes with no rebounds and 7 turnovers. His usual minutes are low (23), so a full-minutes night is the upside case, and it hasn't paid yet.

name: Cameron Boozer
blurb: His shot is the story: 2-15, 5-20 and 4-12 in three of four games, with only one over (25 points on 6-13). The rebounds keep him afloat (7-13) and the minutes are steady at 31-37. If the shooting normalizes, he has room to beat his number.

name: Pascal Siakam
blurb: Near his number in competitive games (in line twice, 35-37 minutes); the one under was a blowout that kept him to 29 minutes. Monday's 13 rebounds were above his norm.

name: Yaxel Lendeborg
blurb: Over ETR in his last two after a quiet opener, on rising scoring (26, then 31) and 9-12 rebounds. Minutes have held in the low-to-mid 30s, so this looks like real production rather than one hot night.

name: Keyonte George
blurb: In line all three, in 29-33 minutes, scoring 19-26 with occasional assist spikes (10 against NOP). ETR has him pegged.

name: Stephen Curry
blurb: Close to his number in 21-30 minutes: in line twice, under once when he added nothing on stocks. Monday's 8-8 shooting still only landed in line, a sign of how much his total leans on scoring alone.

name: Caleb Wilson
blurb: Volatile around ETR: a 7-21 dud, a 30-point, 14-rebound over in 38 minutes, then in line. The over came with extra minutes, so his ceiling depends on playing near 38.

name: James Harden
blurb: A little under-to-in-line: scoring has been light (12-19) on poor shooting, including 1-8 against BKN. Monday's 39 minutes helped him reach his number. The assists (5-9) keep a floor under him.

name: Tyler Herro
blurb: One of each: in line, a 13-point under against PHI, then over Monday on an unusual 10 rebounds. Minutes are fixed at 31-32, so the swings are production, not role.

name: Naz Reid
blurb: Rebounding steadily (11-12 in two of three) in 25-33 minutes. The under came in a 25-minute night with turnovers, when ETR had him above his usual. His shot is streaky (8-22 Monday).

name: Dyson Daniels
blurb: Stocks drive everything: 5 and 8 in his two overs, then 1 in each of the last two. Monday's under was a 2-8, 0-rebound dud. Minutes are steady around 28-35, so expect wide swings that follow his steals and blocks.

name: Kyrie Irving
blurb: Minutes are climbing (24, 25, 33), and he's been in line the last two after an under in the opener. Monday's 33 minutes were his most yet; if that holds, he's trending toward beating his number.

name: Ajay Mitchell
blurb: Over ETR all three games in 23-28 minutes, by 7, 16 and 12. He gets there different ways (6 stocks, then 18 points, then 30 on 10-16). ETR has been chasing him, and the bump with Holmgren out Monday still wasn't enough.

name: Josh Giddey
blurb: Under ETR in two of three in only 24-30 minutes. The misses were a 1-10 shooting night and Monday's 1-rebound, 4-assist game. Without minutes in the 30s he isn't reaching his number.

name: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
blurb: Close to his number in 27-32 minutes, swinging with his shot: over once, under on a cold 5-13 Monday.

name: Isaiah Hartenstein
blurb: In line his last two on big rebounding (12-13 boards) in 26-27 minutes, after a quiet opener. Efficient but low-usage, so his total lives on rebounds.

name: Jarrett Allen
blurb: Never under ETR in three games (two in line, one over), at a steady 27-28 minutes with 7-9 boards every night; the over was a hot 7-8 against BKN. A reliable floor.

name: Aaron Gordon
blurb: Trending down: a hot over against OKC, then cold shooting twice (2-9, 2-10), the latest in a 20-point blowout. Minutes swing with game script (25-37).

name: Ryan Rollins
blurb: Minutes are growing (24, 25, then 32 Monday), and he's been in line the last two after an under. He adds little on stocks, so his number depends on the playing time.

name: Onyeka Okongwu
blurb: Low-scoring (8-11 points) around his number in 26-29 minutes; the one under was a 2-8 night. Nothing distinctive, which is about what ETR expects.
